name: Sluice-Gate Maul
description: A drowned lock-keeper's mallet, swollen and hard as iron.
benefit: Staggers anything braced behind a shield or a door.
cost: Waterlogged weight tires the arms within a few swings.

name: Levy Collector's Baton
description: A varnished truncheon stamped with a satrap's seal.
benefit: Strikes are lawful in any satrapal town, and guards look away.
cost: Every blow is entered in a ledger that someone will read.

name: Chain-Cutter Billhook
description: A hooked blade ground thin on one side for severing links.
benefit: Parts chains, bindings and bound limbs in a single stroke.
cost: The edge chips on anything harder than iron and needs constant care.

name: Quillon of the Oath
description: A short sword whose guard is cast as two clasped hands.
benefit: Strikes against an oath-breaker land with doubled force.
cost: Drawing it against a sworn friend marks the bearer as forsworn.

name: Tithe-Gatherer's Goad
description: A long ox-goad tipped with a bronze barb.
benefit: Drives herded beasts and reluctant debtors alike.
cost: Cattle remember it, and so do the people who owed them.

name: Miasma Pitch Torch
description: A pine brand dipped in black pitch and herbs.
benefit: Burns away foul vapour and drives off carrion things.
cost: Burns bright, and the smoke announces the bearer from afar.

name: Ember Sling of the Last Hour
description: A cord sling with a pouch of fired clay bullets.
benefit: Hurls bullets that carry far and punch through hide.
cost: Each bullet is a single charge, and none are made anymore.

name: Reaped-Grain Scythe
description: A curved blade worn bright by a hundred harvests.
benefit: Sweeps a whole arc of foes at the knee in one pass.
cost: Grief clings to the blade, and the wielder grows slow to flee.

name: Threadspool Lance
description: A lance wrapped with red cord that unspools as it is thrust.
benefit: Reaches past guards, and the cord marks a path home.
cost: The cord snags on every corner and cannot be cut short.

name: Foretold Wasp Needle
description: A long needle etched with a prophecy of the victim's end.
benefit: Finds the gap in any armour when the omen favours it.
cost: Fails entirely against a target whose fate is not yet written.

name: Bronze Oracle Bell
description: A palm-sized bell, cracked and silent for years.
benefit: Rings once to warn of ambush within a bowshot.
cost: Ringing it draws every listener in earshot to the spot.

name: Moon Hunter's Antler Charm
description: A tine of antler on a leather thong, bleached by weather.
benefit: Quiets the step on soft ground and hides scent from game.
cost: The goddess's absence leaves the wearer unable to take any kill cleanly.

name: League Factor's Seal Ring
description: A heavy ring whose bezel prints a merchant's mark.
benefit: Contracts under its seal are honoured in any league port.
cost: Each seal spent leaves a debt on the bearer's name.

name: Cord of the Third Degree
description: A knotted cord worn under the tunic, known only to the initiated.
benefit: Opens inner chambers of the Mysteries to the bearer.
cost: Revealing the cord to an outsider strips the degree at once.

name: Asylum Pebble
description: A smooth stone taken from the boundary of a sanctuary.
benefit: Grants a single night's shelter in any temenos.
cost: Spent once used, and no sanctuary will take the same stone twice.

name: Orichalcum Charge Phial
description: A glass phial packed with refined ore dust.
benefit: Holds a spare charge ready for a failing tool or weapon.
cost: The dust is heavy, brittle, and a prize for thieves.

name: Unburied Mouth-Coin
description: A bronze coin that was never paid to the ferryman.
benefit: Lets the bearer speak with the unquiet dead who owe a debt.
cost: The dead follow the bearer until the coin is laid to rest.

name: Pilgrim's Passage Ledger
description: A slim ledger of stamps from every shrine along the road.
benefit: Waives tolls and hostel fees at shrines on the route.
cost: Skipping a stamped shrine voids the whole book.

name: Tiresias's Blind Coin
description: A coin with both faces worn smooth.
benefit: Shows one true omen about the next choice the bearer faces.
cost: The omen is always true and rarely welcome.

name: Kronos Sundial Shard
description: A broken bronze sundial that still throws a shadow at night.
benefit: Rewinds a single heartbeat of ruinous action, once a day.
cost: Each use ages the bearer a visible year.

name: Tinker's Hearth Kit
description: A roll of awls, rivets and a pocket bellows.
benefit: Mends bronze gear in the field without a forge.
cost: Repairs are crude and leave the piece permanently lighter in worth.

name: Bone-Setter's Splints
description: Polished ash slats and linen binding in a waxed roll.
benefit: Sets a break so it heals in a night, not a month.
cost: Costs a charge of vitality from the bearer to work.

name: Furrow Sower's Dibber
description: A pointed oak stick, black with years of soil.
benefit: Coaxes a handful of grain to sprout on blighted ground.
cost: The crop grows bitter, and no one will buy it kindly.

name: Flood-Mark Plumb Line
description: A lead bob on a knotted line, stained with silt at intervals.
benefit: Reads the height of the next flood from any wall.
cost: The reading is only true within a day, then the line must be reknotted.

name: Shrine Snuffer's Tongs
description: Long iron tongs for lifting hot offerings from a brazier.
benefit: Lifts sacred objects without harm or offence.
cost: Every shrine keeper has a quiet word for those who carry them.

name: Satrap Courier's Scroll Case
description: A tubular case of lacquered leather with a satrapal stamp.
benefit: Carries sealed orders past any checkpoint unopened.
cost: Losing a sealed order is a crime the satrapy never forgives.

name: Unbinding Cutting Loop
description: A wire loop with bone handles, kept oiled in a pouch.
benefit: Frees knots, locks and sealed bindings in a single pull.
cost: What is freed stays free, which is not always what the bearer intended.

name: Hearthwatch Spyglass
description: A bronze tube with a lens of ground rock crystal.
benefit: Reveals movement and campfires on the far horizon.
cost: The glass catches the sun and can be seen as far as it sees.

name: Sanctuary Candle Stub
description: A thumb of white wax wrapped in votive cloth.
benefit: Lights a small circle of safe ground for a night's rest.
cost: Burns down in a single use and cannot be relit.

name: Purse of Last Favours
description: A drawstring purse weighted with a handful of tokens.
benefit: Pays any debt in the Last Favour's own currency of remaining charges.
cost: Each payment leaves every future price a little higher.

name: Ferryman's Lantern Hook
description: A hook pole used to snare lamps from the black water.
benefit: Retrieves items from water, pits and low ledges.
cost: Lanterns hooked from the underworld rarely come back unclaimed.

name: Hecatomb Vesper Vestment
description: A red-dyed linen robe stitched with a count of the slain.
benefit: Recovers vitality slowly whenever blood is spilled nearby.
cost: Sacrificers and their heirs shun its wearer.

name: Oathbound Bronze Harness
description: A close harness of overlapping bronze plates, each engraved with a vow.
benefit: Turns aside blows from any foe the bearer has promised mercy.
cost: Breaking a vow cracks a plate that cannot be mended.

name: Miasma Ward Tabard
description: A tabard soaked in cedar and vinegar, stiff with dried herbs.
benefit: Wards off fever and foul air from the wearer.
cost: The stench drives allies and animals back.

name: Dock Foul-Weather Coat
description: A tarred canvas coat with a hood and many pockets.
benefit: Keeps out rain, spray and cold on long watches.
cost: Heavy when wet, and wet is how it stays.

name: Robe of Loosed Knots
description: A robe fastened by a single cord and no buckles.
benefit: Slips from any grapple or grasping hand.
cost: Falls open at the worst moment, and cannot be fastened tight.

name: Standard-Bearer's Mail
description: A long coat of bronze scale with a socket for a standard.
benefit: Allies within sight stand firm and fight longer.
cost: The standard draws every archer on the field.

name: Kronos Threadbare Shroud
description: A grey shroud that frays whenever it is looked at.
benefit: Dulls the passing of time for slow poisons and bleeding.
cost: Every dawn it frays further and must be darned or lost.

name: Silent Priestess's Robe
description: A white robe without a seam, woven without any words.
benefit: Calms hostile pilgrims and prophets on sight.
cost: The wearer cannot speak a plain lie without a stir.

name: Wallwalker's Jerkin
description: A scuffed leather jerkin sewn with chalk marks inside the collar.
benefit: Protects the ribs when pressed against stone corridors.
cost: The chalk marks fade, and with them the wearer's sense of where the exit lies.

name: Sentinel's Sanctuary Surcoat
description: A white surcoat bearing the seal of a league sanctuary.
benefit: Guards at any sanctuary open ranks for the wearer.
cost: Soiling it with blood is treated as sacrilege.
